verdict.rationale: Skills like xlsx/docx/pdf processing and the general framing 'analyzing data using your organization's specific workflows' show Claude can generate insights/suggestions from user data files via installed Skills, and this is verified hands-on (skill-creator install works). However, this is a generic extensibility mechanism rather than a dedicated insights feature, and community reports show skills are frequently not invoked reliably (56% non-invocation in Vercel eval, users struggling to get skills triggered), undermining consistent delivery of data-driven insights. Missing for 10: dedicated first-party insights/analytics UI, proactive suggestion generation independent of explicit skill invocation, and evidence that skill-based data analysis reliably triggers without manual prompting.
